the RAM under the I/O area holds data, and game.json does not say what it is (kit/skills/c64/c64-reference, "RAM the CPU cannot see"); $D019-$D03D is copied there after the hand-over, which holds it at $1EC6, and 3 more stretches the same way

records.c: Clears $07FF and chooses the two-character filename HL or IL according to $13FA. It passes the filename and logical file parameters to the KERNAL and prepares a return into $1800 after LOAD.
Two consecutive disk filenames. The Fire globe requests HL and the Ice globe requests IL.
Both words hold $17FF, the return address minus one pushed for the interlude load.
Sets the RAM IRQ vector to $1585, enables VIC raster interrupts, disables CIA interrupt sources and schedules the first raster comparison.
Saves registers and brings I/O into view before clearing pending VIC interrupt bits. For a raster interrupt it uses the index at $06 to jump through the table at $15BA.
Little-endian targets for the two opening raster interrupt stages, $15C3 and $15F2.
Six fixed-width screen-code labels per language. They cover the two world globes, high scores, the two disk-side prompts and the three difficulty keys.
Reads the six current score digits in increasing order and stores them in reverse order with the digit character bits set, for comparison with the high score table.
